spans.s:
उद, अम्, n. (only at the beginning or end of a
compound) water.
—उद-कीर्ण or उद-कीर्य, अस्,
m. the tree Galedupa Piscidia, the bark of which is
rubbed and scattered into water to stun the fishes.
—उद-कुम्भ, अस्, m. a water-jar, a jar with water.
—उद-ग्राभ, अस्, m., Ved. holding water.
—उद-
चमस, अस्, m. a cup containing water.
—१. उद-ज,
अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see उद्-अज् 3rd col.), aquatic, watery,
produced in or by water.
—उद-ज्ञ, अस्, m., N. of a
man.
—उद-धान, अस्, आ, अम्, containing water.
—उध-धि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. containing water; (इस्),
m. a water-jar, a reservoir for water; a cloud; a
lake; the ocean.
—उदधि-कुमार, आस्, m. pl. a
class of divinities, belonging to the Bhavanādhīśās.
—उदधि-क्रम, अस्, m. or उदधि-क्रा, आस्, m.,
Ved. a voyager, a mariner.
—उदधि-मल, अस्, m.
cuttle-fish bone.
—उदधि-मेखला, f. the earth
(girdled by the ocean).
—उदधि-राज, अस्, m. the
king of the waters, the ocean.
—उदधि-सुता, f. the
daughter of the ocean; an epithet of Lakṣmī; and
of Dvārakā, the capital of Kṛṣṇa.
—उद-प, अस्, आ,
अम्, crossing the water, as a boat.
—उद-पात्र,
अम्, ई, n. f. a water-jug, a ewer.
—उद-पान, अस्,
अम्, m. n. a well.
—उदपान-मण्डूक, अस्, m. a
frog in a well; (metaphorically) an inexperienced man
of limited ideas who knows only his own neighbour-
hood.
—उद-पू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. cleansing one's self
with water, purified with water.
—उद-पेष, अम्,
n. a paste, anything ground with water; (अम्), ind.
by grinding in water.
—उद-प्रुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. swim-
ming or splashing in water; (Say.) causing water to
flow.
—उद-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. swimming in
water.
—उद-भार, अस्, m. a water-carrier, a cloud.
—उद-भृज्ज and उद-मज्ज, अस्, m., N. of two
men.
—उद-मन्थ, अस्, m. barley-water.
—उद-
मेघ, अस्, m. a watery cloud; a shower of rain.
—उद-लावणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, salted, prepared with
brine.
—उद-वज्र, अस्, m. a thunder-shower, a water-
spout.
—उद-वाप, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उद-
वास, अस्, m. residence in water; (अम्), n. a house
on the margin of a stream or pond, a marine grotto
&c.
—उद-वाह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bringing water;
epithet of the Maruts.
—उद-वाहन, अम्, n. any
[]
water-vessel; a cloud.
—उद-विन्दु, उस्, m. a drop
of water.
—उद-वीवध, अस्, m. a yoke for carrying
water.
—उद-व्रज, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उद-
शराव, अस्, m. a jar filled with water.
—उद-शुद्ध,
अस्, m. a water-jar.
—उद-श्वित्, त्, n. two portions of
buttermilk and one portion of water.
—उद-स्थाली,
f. a caldron, a kettle.
—उद-हरण, अस्, m. a vessel
for drawing water.
—उद-हार, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved.
fetching or carrying water; (अस्), m. a water-carrier,
a cloud.
—उदौदन, see उदकौदन.

उद्दा उद्-दा, cl. 3. P. -ददाति, -दातुम्, to
take away, snatch away.

उदक, अम्, n. water; उदकं दा or प्रदा or
कृ, to offer a libation of water to a dead person
(with gen. or dat. of the person); उदकम् उप-
स्पृश्, to touch certain parts of the body with water,
as prescribed by law; (the word उदक may be used
alone to express this ceremony, e. g. उदकार्थम्,
for the sake of the उदक ceremony.)
—उदक-
कर्मन्, अ, n. or उदक-क्रिया, f. presentation of
water to dead ancestors as far as the fourteenth de-
gree.
—उदक-कार्य, अम्, n. a religious ceremony
performed with water; ablution of the body; obla-
tions to the dead.
—उदक-कुम्भ, अस्, m. a
water-jar.
—उदक-क्रीडन, अम्, n. sporting about
in water.
—उदक-गाह or उद-गाह, अस्, m. enter-
ing the water.
—उदक-गिरि, इस्, m. a mountain
abounding in streams of water.
—उदक-चन्द्र, a
kind of magic.
—उदक-द, अस्, आ, अम्, a giver of
water, yielding water, offering water to the manes;
(अस्), m. an heir, a near kinsman.
—उदक-दातृ,
ता, or उदक-दायिन्, ई, m. one who presents liba-
tions of water to the manes, an heir or kinsman.
—उदक-दान, अम्, n. gift of water, especially to
the manes, as a religious or obsequial rite.
—उदक-
दानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, referring to the above obsequial
rite.
—उदक-धर, अस्, m. ‘water-holder,’ a cloud.
—उदक-पर्वत, अस्, m.; see उदक-गिरि.
—उद-
क-पूर्वकम्, ind. preceded by the water-rite, i. e. by
pouring water on the hand as preparatory to or con-
firmatory of a gift or promise.
—उदक-प्रतीकाश,
अस्, आ, अम्, like water, watery, fluid.
—उदक-भार,
अस्, m. a yoke for carrying water.
—उदक-भूम,
अस्, m. humid soil.
—उदक-मञ्जरी, f. title of a
work on medicine.
—उदक-मण्डलु, उस्, m., Ved.
a water-pitcher.
—उदक-मन्थ or उद-मन्थ,
अस्, m. a kind of peeled grain.
—उदक-मेह, अस्, m.
a sort of diabetes, passing watery urine.
—उदकमे-
हिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from this disease.
—उदक-
वज्र, अस्, m. a thunder-shower, a thunderstorm with
rain; [cf. उद-वज्र.]
—उदक-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
furnished with water.
—उदक-विन्दु, उस्, m. a drop
of water.
—उदक-वीवध, अस्, m. a yoke for carry-
ing water; [cf. उद-वीवध.]
—उदक-शाक, अम्,
n. any aquatic herb.
—उदक-शान्ति, इस्, f. sprinkling
consecrated water over a sick person to allay fever.
—उदक-सक्तु, उस्, m. ground rice moistened with
water.
—उदक-स्पर्श, अस्, आ, अम्, touching different
parts of the body with water; touching water in con-
firmation of a promise.
—उदक-हार, अस्, m. a
water-carrier.
—उदकात्मन् (˚क-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, chiefly
consisting of water, whose chief substance is water.
—उदकाधार (˚क-आध्˚), अस्, m. a reservoir, a
cistern, a well.
—उदकान्त (˚क-अन्˚), अस्, m. margin
of water, bank, shore.
—उदकार्थिन् (˚क-अर्˚), ई,
इनी, इ, desirous of water, thirsty.
—उदकाहार (˚क-
आह्˚), अस्, m. the drawing up of water.
—उदके-चर,
अस्, आ, अम्, moving or living in or inhabiting water.
—उदके-विशीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, dried in water, (a
metaphorical expression for anything unheard of or
impossible.)
—उदकोदञ्जन (˚क-उद्˚), अस्, m. a
water-jar.
—उदकोदर (˚क-उद्˚), अम्, n. dropsy.
—उदकोदरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, dropsical.
—उदकौदन
(˚क-ओद्˚), अस्, m. rice boiled with water.
उदकल, अस्, आ, अम्, watery, containing water.
उदकिल, अस्, आ, अम्, watery, containing water.

उदक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in water; (आ), f. a woman
in her courses (requiring water for purification).

1. उदन्, n. (not used in the nom. sing. du. plur.
and the acc. sing. and du.), Ved. a wave, water.
—उदन्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. wavy, watery,
abounding in water; (आन्), m. the ocean; N. of a
Ṛṣi.

उदन् 2. उद्-अन्, cl. 2. P. -अनिति, -नितुम्, to
breathe upwards, emit the breath in an upward direc-
tion; to breathe.

उदनि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. abounding in waves
or water.

1. उदन्य, nom. P., Ved. उदन्यति, to irrigate;
to thirst, be thirsty.

2. उदन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. watery; (आ), f. thirst.
—उदन्य-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. born in or living in
water.
उदन्य उदन्य. See under 2. उद्.

उदन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. liking or seeking water,
walking in water.
उदक् उदक्. See under 2. उद्-अञ्च्.

उदग्र उद्-अग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, with elevated top,
having the top upwards, over-topping, towering or
pointing upwards; projecting; high, tall, long; ad-
vanced (in age); increased, large, vast, fierce, intense;
excited, enraptured.
—उदग्र-दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, hav-
ing projecting teeth, large-toothed; (अन्), m. an ele-
phant with a large tusk.

उदज् उद्-अज्, cl. 1. P. A. -अजति, -ते, -अजितुम्,
to drive out, expel, pull off.

2. उद्-अज, अस्, m. (for 1. see under उद 1st col.),
the driving out or forth (of cattle &c.).
उद्-आज, अस्, m. leading up or out.

उदजलक उदजलक, अस्, m., N. of a wheel-
wright in the Pañca-tantra.

उदञ्च् 1. उद्-अञ्च् or उद्-अच्, cl. 1. P. A. -अञ्-
चति, -ते, -चितुम्, to elevate, raise up, lift up, throw
up; to send forth, utter, cause to resound.

2. उद्-अञ्च् or उद्-अच्, अङ्, ईची, अक्, turned or going
upwards; upper, upwards; turned to the north, north-
ern (opposed to अधराञ्च् and दक्षिण); subse-
quent, posterior; (क्), ind. above; northward; subse-
quently; उदीची, the northern दिश् or quarter, the
north.
—उदक्तात्, ind., Ved. towards the north,
northward.
—उदक्-पथ, अस्, m. the northern coun-
try.
—उदक्-प्रवण, अस्, आ, अम्, sloping towards
the north; proceeding well (as a sacrifice?).
—उदक्-
सेन, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
—उदग्-अद्रि, इस्, m.
the northern mountain; the Himālaya mountain to
the north of Hindūstan.
—उदग्-अयन, अम्, n. the
sun's progress north of the equator, the half-year from
the winter to the summer solstice.
—उदग्-दश, अस्,
आ, अम्, having the border turned upwards or to the
north.
—उदग्-भूम, अस्, m. fertile soil (turned up-
wards or towards the north).
—उदग्-भूमि, इस्, m.
good or fertile soil.
—उदङ्-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, facing
the north.

उद्-अक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone up, raised up, risen,
ascended; sent forth; uttered.

उद्-अङ्क, अस्, m. a vessel or bucket (for oil &c.,
but not for water); Pāṇini
, N. of a man.

उद्-अञ्चन, अम्, n. a bucket, a pail for drawing
water out of a well; (अम्), n. directing or throwing
upwards; rising, ascending; a cover or lid.

उद्-अञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised up, thrown up,
tossed; worshipped.
उद्-अञ्चु, उस्, m., N. of a man.

उदञ्जलि उद्-अञ्जलि, इस्, इस्, इ, hollowing the
palms and then raising them.

उदण्डपाल उद्-अण्ड-पाल, अस्, m. a kind of
fish; a sort of snake.
उदधि उद-धि. See under उद.

उद्-आन, अस्, m. breathing upwards, breathing,
breath; one of the three or five vital airs, that which
rises up the throat and passes into the head; (with
Buddhists) an expression of joy or praise; the navel;
an eyelash; a kind of snake.
उदान उद्-आन. See under 2. उद्-अन्, p. 153.

उद्दान उद्-दान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 4. दा, to
bind, with उद्), binding, confinement; taming, subdu-
ing; the middle, the waist; a fire-place; submarine
fire; entrance of the sun into a sign of the zodiac.

उदन्त उद्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reaching to the
end or border of anything; (अस्), m. ‘telling to the
end,’ full tidings, intelligence; news; a pure and
virtuous man; supporting one's self by sacrificing for
others; one who gets a livelihood by a trade &c.

उद्-दान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, energetic, humble, elevated;
(? for उद्-वान्त), vomited by an elephant.
उदन्तक, अस्, m. news, tidings, intelligence.
उद्-अन्तिका, f. satisfaction, satiety.

उदन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, living beyond a limit or
boundary.
उदय उद्-अय, &c. See under उद्-इ 3rd col.

उद्-अय, अस्, आ, अम्, (in gram.) following, coming
after or upon (as one letter, accent &c. upon another);
(अस्), m. going upwards; rising (of the sun or planets
or of a cloud); the eastern mountain behind which
the sun is supposed to rise; coming forth, creation,
production, becoming visible, appearance, develop-
ment; light, splendor; conclusion, result, conse-
quence; rising, reaching one's aim, elevation; profit,
advantage, income, revenue, interest; outlet, exit; N.
of the seventh Arhat of the future Utsarpiṇi, = Udayā-
[]
śva; a son of Yājñika; a follower of Śākya-muni.
—उदय-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उदय-जित्,
त्, m., N. of a son of Guṇala.
—उदय-धवल, अस्,
m., N. of a prince.
—उदय-पर्वत, अस्, m. or
उदय-गिरि, इस्, m. or उदय-शैल, अस्, m. or
उदयाचल (˚य-अच्˚), अस्, m. or उदयाद्रि (˚य-
अद्˚), इस्, m. the eastern mountain behind which the
sun rises.
—उदय-पुर, अम्, n., N. of the capital
of Marvar.
—उदय-प्रस्थ, अस्, m. the plateau of
the mountain behind which the sun rises.
—उदय-
राज, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उदय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
risen.
—उदय-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—उदया-
दित्य (˚य-आद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उदयाश्व
(˚य-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a grandson of Ajāta-śatru.
उद्-आय. See s. v. त्र्य्-उदाय.

उदर उदर, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ऋ with उद्?),
the belly; a cavity, the interior or inside of anything
(e. g. उदरे, inside, in the interior); enlargement of
the abdomen from dropsy or flatulence, any mor-
bid abdominal affection, as liver, spleen, &c., a class
of eight different diseases; the thick, inner side of
the अन्गुष्ठ or thumb; slaughter; [cf. Lat. uterus.]
—उदर-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. disease of the spleen, lit.
‘knot of the belly’ (a chronic affection of this organ
not uncommon in India).
—उदर-त्राण, अम्, n. a
cuirass, armour covering the front of the body; a
girth, a belly-band.
—उदर-दार, अस्, m., Ved. a
particular disease of the belly.
—उदर-पिशाच, अस्,
m. a glutton, voracious, one who devours everything,
flesh, fish, &c.
—उदर-पूरम्, ind. till the belly is
full.
—उदर-पोषण, अम्, n. feeding the belly, sup-
porting life.
—उदर-भरण-मात्र-केवलेच्छु
(˚ल-इच्˚), उस्, उस्, उ, desirous only of the mere filing
of the belly.
—उदरम्-भरि, इस्, इस्, इ, nourishing
only one's own belly, selfishly voracious, gluttonous.
—उदर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a large belly,
corpulent.
—उदर-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping on the
face or belly.
—उदर-शाण्डिल्य, अस्, m., N. of a
sage.
—उदर-सर्वस्व, अस्, m. an epicure, a glutton.
—उदराध्मान (˚र-आध्˚), अम्, n. flatulence of
the body.
—उदरामय (˚र-आम्˚), अस्, m. disease
of the belly, dysentery, diarrhœa.
—उदरामयिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, suffering from dysentery or diarrhœa.
—उद-
रावर्त (˚र-आव्˚), अस्, m. the navel.
—उदरावेष्ट
(˚र-आव्˚), अस्, m. tape worm.

उदार उद्-आर, अस्, आ, or ई, अम् (fr. rt. ऋ with
उद्), high, lofty, exalted, noble, illustrious, generous,
liberal, gentle, munificent, great, best; upright, honest,
sincere; proper, right; eloquent; unperplexed; Ved.
causing to rise, exciting, driving forth; (अम्), ind.
aloud; (अस्), m., Ved. a rising fog or vapour; a sort
of grain with long stalks; a figure in rhetoric, attri-
buting nobleness to an inanimate object; (आस्), pl.
nebulous forms, spirits (?).
—उदार-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्,
of a generous disposition, noble-minded.
—उदार-
[]
चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, high-minded, magnanimous.
—उदा-
र-ता, f. liberality, generosity.
—उदार-धी, ईस्, ईस्,
इ, highly intelligent, wise, sagacious, noble-minded.
—उदार-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of great power.
—उदार-
सत्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, generous-minded.
उदरक, अस्, ई, अम्, abdominal.
उदारक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
उदरिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a large belly.

उदरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a large belly, fat, corpu-
lent; abdominal; (इणी), f. a pregnant woman.
उदरिल, अस्, आ, अम्, fat, corpulent.

उदर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the belly; (अम्),
n., Ved. contents of the belly or what forms the
belly.

उदरथि उद्-अरथि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. ऋ with उद्?),
the sun; the ocean.

उदारथि उद्-आरथि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. ऋ with
उद्?), Ved. steaming (as a hot dish); (Sāy.) rising,
or enlightening the organs of sense; (इस्), m. an
epithet of Viṣṇu.
उदर्क उद्-अर्क. See under उद्-ऋच् at p. 155.

उद्-अर्क, अस्, m. reaching or extending beyond,
surpassing; the future result of actions; consequence,
futurity, future time; a remote consequence, reward;
conclusion, end; elevation of a building, a tower,
look-out place; the plant Vanguiera Spinosa.

उदर्चिस् उद्-अर्चिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, shining or blaz-
ing upwards, luminous; (इस्), m. a N. of fire; of
Śiva, of Kandarpa.

उदर्ज् उद्-अर्ज्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -अर्जति, -जितुम्,
to drive out, remove.

उदर्द् उद्-अर्द्, cl. 1. P. -अर्दति, -दितुम्, to
strike or beat upon.
उद्-अर्द, अस्, m. (in medic.) erysipelas.

उदर्द्ध उद्-अर्द्ध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ऋध् with
उद्), scarlet fever.
उदल उदल, अस्, m., N. of a man.

उद्दाल उद्-दाल, अस्, m. (fr. दॄ with उद् ?),
the plant Cordia Myxa or Latifolia; also Paspalum
Frumentaceum.
—उद्दाल-वत्, आन्, m., N. of a Gan-
dharba.

उदव् उद्-अव्, cl. 1. P. -अवति, -वितुम्, to re-
gard, attend to; to wait for; to promote, impel.

उदवग्रह उद्-अवग्रह, अस्, m. a Svarita
accent depending on an Udātta which stands in the
अव-ग्रह (q. v.). See तैरोविराम.

उदवसानीय उद्-अवसानीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
सो with अव and उद्), Ved. concluding, final.
उद्-अवसित, अम्, n. a house, dwelling.

उदश् उद्-अश्, cl. 5. P. A. -अश्नोति, -नुते,
अशितुम् or -अष्टुम्, to reach to the top of, reach,
attain; to be able, be master of.

उदस् उद्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -सितुम्, to cast
[]
or throw up; to raise, erect, elevate; to throw out,
expel.

उदास् उद्-आस्, cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to sit
separate or away from, to sit on one side or apart,
not to share in, not to show interest in; to be un-
concerned about, to be indifferent or passive.

उदश्रु उद्-अश्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, one whose tears
gush forth, weeping.
उद्-असन, अम्, n. throwing up, raising, erecting.

उद्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast up, raised,
thrown; cast out, expelled; removed, scattered, hum-
bled, shamed.

1. उद्-आस, अस्, m. throwing or directing upwards,
elevation.

2. उद्-आस, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see under उद्-अस्),
indifferent, unconcerned, apathetic; (अस्), m. a stoic,
a philosopher; indifference, apathy, stoicism.

उदाकृ उद्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. 5. P. A. -कृणोति,
-णुते, -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to expel; to fetch
out of; to select; A. to overpower.

उदाख्या उद्-आ-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -तुम्,
to relate aloud; enunciate.

उदागा उद्-आ-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to
come up or out towards.

उदाचक्ष् उद्-आ-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, to
declare aloud.

उदाचर् उद्-आ-चर्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -चरति,
-रितुम्, -र्तुम्, Ved. -रितवे, -तवै, -रसे, -रध्-
यै, to rise from or out of.

उदाजन् उद्-आ-जन्, cl. 4. A., Ved. -जायते,
-जनितुम्, to arise from; to become visible above.

उदातन् उद्-आ-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -नुते,
-नितुम्, to erect one's self, to rise.

उदादा उद्-आ-दा, cl. 3. P., Ved. -ददाति, -दा-
तुम्, to lift up, elevate.

उद्-आत्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for उद्-आ-दत्त), elevated,
high, upraised, lofty; highly or acutely accented;
great, illustrious; generous, gentle, and bountiful;
giving, a donor; dear, beloved; (अस्), m. the acute
accent, a high or sharp tone; a gift, donation; a
kind of musical instrument, a large drum; an orna-
ment or figure of speech in rhetoric; work, business;
(अम्), n. an ornament or figure in rhetoric.
—उदात्त-
तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more elevated, more acute.
—उदात्-
त-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having the acute accent.
—उदात्त-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, similar to the high
tone or accent.
—उदात्त-राघव, अम्, n. title of a
drama.
—उदात्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pronounced with
the acute accent.
—उदात्त-श्रुति, इस्, इस्, इ, pronounced
with the Udātta accent.
—उदात्तश्रुति-ता, f. the state
of being pronounced with the acute accent.

उदाद्यन्त उद्-आद्य्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded
and followed by an Udātta.

उदानी उद्-आ-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते,
-नेतुम्, to lead up (out of water); to elevate.

उदाप् उद्-आप्, cl. 5. P., Ved. -आप्नोति, -आप्तुम्,
to reach up to, reach, attain.
उदापि उद्-आपि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Sahadeva.

उदाप्यम् उद्-आप्यम्, ind., Ved. up the stream,
against stream.

उदायम् उद्-आ-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्-
तुम्, to show, to make known.
उदायस उद्-आयस, अस्, m., N. of a prince.

उदायुध उद्-आयुध, अस्, आ, अम्, with uplifted
weapon, upraising weapons.

उदावत्सर उदावत्सर, अस्, m. a year, one of
the five years forming a period. See इदावत्सर.

उदावर्त उद्-आवर्त, अस्, m. a class of diseases,
marked by the retention of the excrements; disease
of the bowels, iliac passion; (आ), f. painful menstrua-
tion with foamy blood.
उदावर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from such diseases.

उदावसु उदावसु, उस्, m., N. of a king of
Videha, a son of Janaka; [cf. उपावसु.]

उद्-आसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, indifferent, disregarding,
stoical, one void of concern or affection.

उद्-आसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, indifferent, disregarding; (ई),
m. a stoic, a philosopher; one who has no passion
nor affection for anything; in popular acceptation, a
religious mendicant in general, or one of a particular
order.

उद्-आसीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting apart, indifferent,
free from affection; (in law) not involved in the
dispute; (अस्), m. a stranger, a neutral, a common
acquaintance, a person neither a friend nor a foe.
—उदासीन-ता, f. indifference, apathy.

उदास्थित उद्-आस्थित, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्था
with आ and उद्), a superintendent, a doorkeeper; a
spy, an emissary; an ascetic who has given up his
vow; (अस्, आ, अम्), set over.

उदाहित उद्-आहित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धा with
आ and उद्), elevated, raised.

उदाहृ उद्-आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते,
-हर्तुम्, to relate, declare, announce; illustrate.

उद्-आहरण, अम्, n. relating, saying, declaring,
declaration; referring a general rule to a special case,
an example or illustration; an apposite argument, the
third of the five premises of rhetorical reasoning; the
example or third member in a fivefold syllogism.

उद्-आहार, अस्, m. an example or illustration; the
beginning of a speech.

उद्-आहार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be referred as a general
rule to a special case.

उद्-आहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, said, illustrated, called,
named, entitled.
उद्-आ-हृति, इस्, f. an example, an illustration.
उद्-अयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going upwards, rising.

उद्-अयन, अम्, n. rising, ascending (of the sun);
exit, result; conclusion, end; (अस्), m. an epithet of
Agastya; N. of a king of Vatsa; N. of a Purohita of
king Śuddhodana.
—उदयन or उदयनाचार्य, अस्,
m. a philosopher and violent persecutor of the Bud-
dhists.
—उदयन-चरित, अम्, n. title of a play.

उदयनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to an end or
conclusion, finishing (as a ceremony).

उद्-अयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, rising, ascending, prosperous,
flourishing; (ई), m., N. of a man.
—उदयि-भद्र,
अस्, m., N. of a son of Ajāta-śatru.

उद्दंश उद्-दंश, अस्, m. (rt. दंश्), a bug;
a mosquito, a gadfly.

उद्दण्ड उद्-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, whose staff is
raised, whose stalk is erect; raised on a staff or pole.
—उद्दण्ड-पाल, अस्, m. a punisher, whether king
or magistrate; a sort of snake, a kind of fish; [cf.
उद्-अण्ड-पाल.]

उद्दन्तुर उद्-दन्तुर, अस्, आ, अम्, large-toothed,
having projecting teeth; high, tall; terrific^1, for-
midable.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.

उद्दम् उद्-दम्, cl. 4. P. -दाम्यति, -दमितुम्,
cl. 10. P. -दमयति, -यितुम्, to subdue, to over-
power, become master of.
उद्-दम, अस्, m. subduing, overpowering.

उद्-दाम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उद् and दामन्, a bond),
unrestrained, unbound, set free; self-willed; unlimited,
extraordinary; proud, haughty; large, great; (अस्),
m. an epithet of Yama (‘whose noose is raised’); an
epithet of Varuṇa; (अम्), ind. in an unrestrained
manner, without any limits.

उद्दालक, अस्, m., N. of the above plants; N. of
a teacher; (अम्), n. a kind of honey.
—उद्दालक-
पुष्प-भञ्जिका, f. ‘breaking of Uddālaka flowers,’
a sort of game played by people in the eastern districts.
उद्दालिन्, ई, m., N. of a teacher.
उद्-दर्शन, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Nāgas.
उदाशय (˚द-आश्˚), अस्, अम्, m. n. a lake, tank.
